name: Incentfit
summary: Incentfit runs structured individual and team wellness challenges, gives employees health education and a content hub, and offers real-time, exportable reports on participation. Its pricing page lists per-employee monthly rates from $1.80 to $6.00.

facts.text: Incentfit's page says the platform offers unlimited, customizable individual or team wellness challenges on the Essentials, Engage and Empower plans.

According to the vendor's page, the platform gives employees trusted health education, resources and personalized wellness guidance, and it lists a health encyclopedia and newsfeed for ongoing education on the Engage and Empower plans.
According to the page, the platform delivers real-time dashboards and exportable reports that track participation, spending and compliance outcomes.
The page does not describe health coaching or health screenings.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page lists amounts per employee per month. The page does not say how a minimum headcount or contract length affects the bill.
